description: Source code for the mc3419 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing sensor initialization, configuration, data fetching, and trigger handling.

methods.name: mc3419_get_odr_value
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the output data rate (ODR) value matching the given frequency parameters.

methods.name: mc3419_set_op_mode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the MC3419 sensor via I2C register.

methods.name: mc3419_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data samples from the device.

methods.name: mc3419_to_sensor_value
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to a sensor_value structure considering sensitivity.

methods.name: mc3419_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific sensor channel data (X, Y, Z, or XYZ).

methods.name: mc3419_set_accel_range
methods.description: Configures the accelerometer range and updates sensitivity accordingly.

methods.name: mc3419_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (ODR) for the sensor.

methods.name: mc3419_set_anymotion_threshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold for any-motion detection trigger.

methods.name: mc3419_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures a trigger for the sensor (if triggers are enabled).

methods.name: mc3419_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: mc3419_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks I2C readiness, and sets up semaphores and triggers.
